Hazard to navigation
Orange 16ft long target weighing approximately 1,000 pounds may be floating on the surface. Mariners are requested to use caution when operating In the Area of position 22-56N/ 160-51W. If this target is found please contact the Pacific Missile Range Facility at 808- 335-4523. Do not attempt to recover this device due to risk of injury or property damage because of it's size and weight.
